    direction TB
        J["Reconciliation Trigger<br>Scheduled / Manual / Event"]
        K["Load Approved Desired State"]
        L["Read Actual Server State"]
        M{"Drift Detected?"}
        N["Compliant State"]
        O["Remediate Delta"]
        P["Publish Compliance Event<br>Drift / Correction / Evidence"]
  end
 subgraph BG["Emergency Access Path"]
    direction TB
        BG1["Critical Incident / Platform Failure"]
        BG2["Break-Glass Approval<br>Dual Control / Emergency Approval"]
        BG3["Vault / Secure Credential Store"]
        BG4["Temporary Emergency Access"]
        BG5["Full Audit Logging / Session Evidence"]

        BG7["Reconciliation Removes Unapproved Residual Changes"]
  end
 subgraph PIPE["Pipeline / Automation Identity Path"]
    direction TB
        P1["Pipeline or Deployment Workflow"]
        P2["Call AGF API"]
        P3["Create NPA via Governed API Path"]
        P4["Register Metadata in CMDB"]
  end
    A["ServiceNow Catalog Request<br>NPA details, target scope, rights, justification"] --> B{"Approval<br>ServiceNow or IAM"}
    B -- Approved --> C["Approved Request"]
    B -- Rejected --> A
    C --> D["AGF Identity Governance<br>Creates NPA in Active Directory"]
    D --> E["CMDB Updated<br>Store approved metadata and targeting facts<br>OAR, environment, servers,<br>system role, permission pattern"]
    E --> F["Automation Controller<br>Query CMDB"]
    T["Targeting Options<br>By OAR / Environment / Role / Server Name"] -. reference .-> F
    F --> G["Resolve Desired Configuration<br>Local groups, user rights, bindings"]
    G --> H["Apply Configuration on Target Servers"]
    H --> I["Execution Result<br>Success / Partial / Failure"]
    J --> K
    K --> L
    L --> M
    M -- No --> N
    M -- Yes --> O
    O --> P
    E -. desired state source .-> J
    H -. current enforced state .-> J
    P --> Q["Azure Monitor / Arc"] & R1["SIEM / Security Monitoring"] & S["ServiceNow Incident / Task<br>Optional"] & U["Windows Event Log / JSON Log<br>Optional"]
    BG1 --> BG2
    BG2 --> BG3
    BG3 --> BG4
    BG4 --> BG5 & BG6
    BG6 --> BG7
    BG7 --> P
    P1 --> P2
    P2 --> P3
    P3 --> P4
    P4 --> F
